title: A Interior for the Language
author: Wendell Reyes
blurb: Lena Yarrow, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
